checks.evidence: full.jpg and thumb_200: at night, a shop owner seen from behind pulls his shutter down on a wet Tirana street, with the clock tower at the end of the street. The three-line headline reads in about a second with the sound off.
It matches the hook line 'Kjo javë e vështirë është për tani, jo përgjithmonë.' and the reel's frame 1: a calm moment as he closes up, with no drama.
There are no numbers, claims, prices, client names or results anywhere. Nothing contradicts the script or brand-kit.md.

One hand shows: his right hand on the bottom shutter slat, with four fingers over the slat face and the thumb hidden behind. It is attached through the cuff and sleeve. The other arm is out of view in front of his body, and both legs reach the pavement (tile_r3c2). Owner pixels are unchanged from v3 before the JPEG save (max diff 0).
The hand grips the shutter's bottom slat in a pull-down grip. It has a sharp edge with no halo (handcuff_4x; ov_hand_5x shows the edit footprint stops at the hand and post A).
No face is shown, only the back of the head and the ear in lost profile, which look natural. These pixels are unchanged from v3.

The hand sits on the slat, the phone is seated in the jacket pocket, and both feet are on the wet pavement with reflections under them. The window glass now reads as soft defocused or fogged glass behind a sharp frame. At 1x this reads as glass, and it is the treatment the v3 and v4 reports asked for (not counted).

The window structure is whole and straight: the shutter and top rail, post A between the two panes, the right frame post, the glazing beads, the lit sill and the base panels. Post A is sharp from under the cuff down to its base below the sill. Its lit cap at y 1690-1715 is sharp, as in v3, where v4 had a glow over a sharp base. The glass meets each frame line with a 1 px edge, leaving no sharp sliver and no dark or light halo.

I read it letter by letter. Line 1: 'Kjo javë e vështirë' (K-j-o, j-a-v-ë, e, v-ë-s-h-t-i-r-ë). Line 2: 'është për tani,' (ë-s-h-t-ë, p-ë-r, t-a-n-i, comma). Line 3: 'jo përgjithmonë.' (j-o, p-ë-r-g-j-i-t-h-m-o-n-ë, full stop). Every ë is correct and there are no em dashes. Word gaps measure 25 to 36 px and differ only with glyph shape (the j hook, the v diagonal). The third plate is RGB (179, 18, 23), which is #B31217 exactly. Lines 1 and 2 are ivory on dark plates.

The text sits on its plates, over the shutter and the sky. The plates end at y 703 and the top of his head is at about y 785, so nothing covers the head and no text touches skin, clothes or the phone.

WINDOW, the v3 FL-10 area: at 2x (win2x_top, win2x_bot, region_COVER_window, tile_r3c1), at 4x (w4x_r0c0 to w4x_r3c1, covering all glass, and region_COVER_red_can) and in a CLAHE contrast-boosted 2x view (win2x_clahe), there are only soft shelf masses and light blobs. No stroke, letter or number shape is left, and the red can is a soft red-brown blob. The sigma 9 blur reaches every glass pixel up to the 1 px frame edge and the 2 px owner band. BACKGROUND: the street sign at x 650-700, y 1075-1105 is a blank blue-white glow (bg_sign_4x). The red awning is plain (bg_right_3x). The clock faces are blank lit discs with no numerals (bg_clock_4x). The pillar and the panel right of the hem show no marks (pillar_3x). Two tiny warm specks on the lit sill (about x 202, y 1693 and x 224, y 1661) are v3 reflections, not letters.
The story props are there and have their content: the shutter is being pulled, the red phone with its camera bump sits in the left jacket pocket, and the lit shop window glows warm behind him.
The phone has the style bible's deep red case. Its pixels are unchanged from v3.
There are no unexplained props. The edit added nothing: its footprint is the glass only.
This is the same owner as the reel and the v3 cover: dark jacket with a hem grommet, grey-dark hair, dark trousers. He is identical to v3 before the JPEG save.
Continuity with the reel's frame 1 holds: hand on the shutter, phone in the left pocket, shutter at the same height.
The set is 'Tirana after dark': the clock tower, a wet tiled street, warm street lamps and a lit shop window.

The cover is 1080x1920 (9:16). The plates run x 60 to about 1000, inside the 4% margin, with ink from x 72. The headline runs y 310-703. It starts in the top third, and in the 3:4 grid crop (y 240-1680) it sits wholly inside that crop's top third, ending at 720. Its last 63 px run past y 640 on the full 9:16 frame. That is unchanged since v3 and was accepted by the v3 and v4 reviews, so I do not count it.

At 200 px wide, all three headline lines are readable, and the owner, the shutter, the red phone and the clock tower read clearly. In the 3:4 centre crop at 200 and 360 px, the headline sits in the top third and the owner and clock tower are clear. The window reads as a calm warm glow behind dark, sharp posts, like v4, with nothing busy left.
The background is alive: a walker mid-stride in the street, distant figures and lit shopfronts, consistent with a realistic night scene.

It matches the style bible: tungsten night grade, near-black scene, ivory type, crimson #B31217 highlight. The glass keeps the warm tungsten tone, 12% darker (mean luma 103.3 to 90.8), so the window no longer pulls focus.
The textures are photo-real: the jacket's cloth folds, the hand's skin, the wet tiles. The owner and street are untouched v3 pixels with no plastic look.
